{
  "admissible_variables": [
    "calendar",
    "cost_ratio",
    "current_load",
    "horizon",
    "lagged_load",
    "load_statistics",
    "observed_weather",
    "recent_ramp",
    "region_id"
  ],
  "audit_log": {
    "human_approval_required": true,
    "triggered_rules": []
  },
  "decision": "accept",
  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",
    "numerical_workflow_outputs",
    "audit_log"
  ],
  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an audit-ready upward reserve sizing study for MISO with a 120-minute horizon and shortfall cost 10.0. Only decision-time admissible variables are used: calendar, cost ratio, current load, horizon, lagged load, load statistics, observed weather, recent ramp, and region ID. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "The request specifies a supported region (MISO), a supported horizon (120 minutes), and a supported shortfall cost (10.0). It restricts inputs to decision-time load history, ramps, calendar, and observed weather, which are admissible and avoid future information, test-residual leakage, raw-data modification, fabricated results, and approval bypasses.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "MISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 120,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 10.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "enforce_decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "configure_rolling_window_train_730_cal_30_test_30_step_30",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "emit_numerical_outputs_only_from_verified_workflow",
    "require_human_approval_before_operational_use"
  ]
}
